messages:
maria: Heads up — need to provision a new GKE GPU node pool for nightly batch burst (model evals). Quota request taking too long, can we sketch config here?

raj: What's the target region and instance type? We should avoid H100 for batch; A10G or A2 cheaper. Also prefer spot for burst.

sam: Region us-central1. Prefer a10g if available; fallback to a2-highgpu-1 for cost. Target steady 6 nodes, burst to 18.

jo: Suggest two pools: compact-dedicated (3 nodes, guaranteed, no preemptibles) tainted gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule, and burst-spot (spot, max 15) tainted gpu=spot:NoSchedule. Autoscaler on both.

maria: yea. Autoscaler profile: aggressive scale-up for nightly jobs, gentler scale-down during day. Proposed CA flags:
```
--expander=least-waste
--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m
--scale-down-delay-after-add=15m
--balance-similar-node-groups
```

raj: Add node labels for workload isolation and node-affinity: gpu-type=a10g|a2, workload=eval. Also pod disruption budgets for eval controllers.

lisa: Quota: current GPU quota in us-central1 is 12. Need to request 30. I filed GCP case 12345678 yesterday, no response yet. infra-bot: submitted case #12345678 to GCP — expected reply 48-72h.

infra-bot: Quota case 12345678: status=OPEN, requested_increase=+18 GPUs for us-central1. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/12345678

sam: If quota delayed, fallback to multi-region (use us-east1 as secondary) and split pool. Jo, are network egress rules okay for cross-region scheduling?

jo: Need to ensure VPC peering and firewall rules allow inter-region node pool images and NAT. Also watch out for egress IP limits when burst spins many nodes.

maria: Cost check — burst spot A10G ~ $0.60/hr vs on-demand H100 ~ $3.2/hr. Rough monthly estimate for nightly 6hr burst: 15 nodes * 6h * 30d * $0.6 ~= $1,620. Fine for experiments.

raj: Also enable node-local caching for Docker layers and set imagePullPolicy=IfNotPresent to speed startup.

jo: Pushing a kustomize patch to repo: the node pool config + taints + autoscaler flags. I'll post PR shortly.

maria: awesome. If quota still not approved by EOD, plan B: reduce burst max to 10 and schedule staggered evals.

lisa: noted. Will ping GCP rep + escalate if no reply in 24h :phone:
